title: CSV Import Contract
job: Turn legacy CSV/XLSX exports into a repeatable, reviewable import contract with inspectable parsing assumptions, mappings, deterministic transformations, validations, and handoff artifacts.
user: Implementation consultants and operations staff preparing legacy exports for system migrations.
constraints: Error reports preserve original row numbers and values
success_measure: 75% of files pass a second independent import using the contract without a new manual cleanup step.
